description: This file is a PHP source file for editing wireless network configuration settings in a web-based UI. It includes PHP code, embedded JavaScript, HTML, and references to other includes, handling the display and submission of wireless network parameters such as SSID, security mode, channels, and passwords.
published: Form submission handling for wireless settings

methods.name: KeyExtGet
methods.description: Retrieves structured wireless configuration parameters from device management extension.

methods.name: click_save
methods.description: Handles the AJAX POST request to save wireless network settings.

methods.name: setResetInfo
methods.description: Performs reset or restore actions via AJAX POST request.
